configuration.normalization: RGB / 127.5 - 1; equal patch mean; no fitted transform
configuration.kernel: 1 + upper_dot/147 + lower_dot/147 + product of both dots
configuration.loss: class-balanced, then source-balanced, then path-balanced squared error plus ridge
configuration.targets: positive +1; explicit internal/structure opposition -1; other roles masked
configuration.split: leave one entire recording out, all four fixed folds
configuration.optimizer: one float64 linear solve per arm/channel/fold

peak_rss.method: process-lifetime peak RSS; one sample per fresh process
